note.zh-TW: 模板沒有存貨減少列；存貨減少時以反號（正數）填在同一列並加註，這是網站照課程模板填寫的做法。
note.en: The template has no inventory decrease line; a decrease is entered on the same line with the opposite sign (a positive figure) and a note, which is how the site follows the course template.

definition.zh-TW:
間接法裡的調整列：本期存貨比期初多了多少。

存貨增加表示有一部分錢變成了倉庫裡的商品，這筆支出不在損益表的營業成本裡，所以要從稅前淨利扣掉。
definition.en:
An adjustment line in the indirect method: how much inventories have grown since the start of the period.

An increase means money has been turned into goods sitting in the warehouse; that spending is not in cost of sales on the income statement, so it is deducted from profit before tax.

example.zh-TW: 位置：現金流量表營業活動的營運資金變動區。故事裡進貨之後、賣出之前，這一列是負數。課程模板沒有「存貨減少」列，存貨減少時以正數（反號）填在同一列並加註；現行報表寫成「存貨（增加）減少」一行。
example.en: Where it sits: the working capital section of operating activities in the statement of cash flows. In the story, between buying goods and selling them, this line is negative. The course template has no decrease line, so a fall in inventories is entered on this same line as a positive figure (the opposite sign) with a note; current statements show one line for the net change.

misconception.zh-TW: 以為進貨當下營業成本就增加了。課程版面的營業成本是用期初存貨加本期進貨減期末存貨算出來的，沒賣掉的進貨會留在期末存貨裡，不會進營業成本；可是買進的存貨要付錢（賒購還沒付的部分，由應付帳款增加(+) 那一列加回），所以要靠這一列調整。
misconception.en: Assuming cost of sales rises the moment goods are bought. In the course layout cost of sales is opening inventories plus purchases minus closing inventories, so unsold purchases stay in closing inventories and never reach cost of sales; the goods still have to be paid for (on a credit purchase, the increase in trade payables line adds the unpaid amount back), which is why this line adjusts for it.
